decision_reason: HistGradientBoosting has the lowest average development MAE, but its advantage over LightGBM is only 0.5596% and it wins 2 of 5 matched MAE folds versus 3 wins for LightGBM. The evidence is therefore not sufficiently consistent to justify reopening the finalized production pipeline.
note: This supplementary experiment does not erase the fact that 2024/2025 were used elsewhere in the finalized historical pipeline; it only records that they were not loaded by this experiment step.
